nodes.rationale: Audit finding #3 (high): the carry-forward fix for e18's under-trade bug had no staleness bound, so a stale term structure could still decide. Set to 2 sessions; e18 now REFUSES to decide rather than guessing. The exact 5-session lag that inverted the signal on 07-17 would now be blocked.

nodes.label: Idempotent-Only Broker Retry Policy
nodes.rationale: Audit finding #6: 3x HTTP 500 on 2026-07-23, all on idempotent endpoints. Retry added for GET/DELETE only. POST /v2/orders is NEVER auto-retried, because a timed-out submit may have landed - a missed order self-heals via reconcile, a duplicate does not.

nodes.label: e18 Permanent Share Fork (+0.864%)
nodes.rationale: Audit finding #4: record DE's 'self-heals at Tue open' was WRONG - it re-converged in STATE, never in QUANTITY. Measured: DB 1.3957099 vs Alpaca 1.4077634 = +0.864% (+$8.14); e6/m10 drift is -0.001%/-0.014% rounding. Deliberately NOT traded away: the DB ledger is the primary evidence and is next-open disciplined, so it is never rewritten to match a broker fill, and placing bookkeeping orders is a trading-behavior change requiring Evan's call.

nodes.label: report_mirror_drift()
nodes.rationale: The chosen response to the untraded share fork: print the DB-vs-broker gap every run and flag at >=0.25%, so comparisons are made knowing the offset instead of silently absorbing it.

nodes.label: SwingTradingDailyPaper Scheduled Task
nodes.rationale: Windows task, weekdays 19:00 local, StartWhenAvailable, 30-min limit, now running S4U so it fires with nobody logged on. ONE invocation runs all 3 sleeves together per Evan. The 7pm cadence exists because Yahoo's same-session bar can be incomplete for hours after close. Do NOT fire it manually intraday - that caused the 07-20 round-trip and the e18 fork.

nodes.label: scripts/daily_swing_paper.bat
nodes.rationale: Pure ASCII by hard rule (cmd.exe silently corrupts its parse on a single non-ASCII byte); .gitattributes pins *.bat text eol=crlf and the file is CRLF on disk. cd+venv+script+log chain; logs to var/daily_swing_paper.log.

nodes.label: scripts/daily_swing_paper.py
nodes.rationale: One evening run per day: realizes the prior run's pending at today's now-known open, then stores today's close signal as tomorrow's pending - so it needs no separate morning touch. Dry-run default; --execute does a per-account flatten-then-enter across all 3 sleeves.

nodes.label: swing_bot/paper_sleeves.py
nodes.rationale: Sleeve DB schema (paper_sleeves/paper_positions/paper_transactions/paper_nav/fill_divergence) plus the decide_* signal functions. New tables by design - it does not touch the pinned bars rows or anything test_frozen.py reads. Each decide_* reuses the IDENTICAL condition as its backtest runner (same SMA window / VIX threshold / residual_series FF3 machinery) for implementation-fidelity.

nodes.label: swing_bot/alpaca_client.py
nodes.rationale: PORTED, not imported, from Trading's client (that repo is read-only from here). Paper base URL default with a hard live-guard requiring allow_live=True, which nothing in this project passes. No PDT field reads (grep-confirmed). Two real format bugs were caught in the 3-account rewire: the base URL ends in /v2 and would double to /v2/v2/..., and Alpaca rejects notional+limit orders.

nodes.label: client_for_sleeve()
nodes.rationale: The rewire from the single-mirror model to the 3-account model: each sleeve mirrors to its own $1,000 Alpaca paper account, so isolation is real rather than bookkept.

nodes.label: realize_pending()
nodes.rationale: The dry-run caught a real non-idempotency here: re-running the same day filled a pending order against its own signal day's open. Fixed by requiring a strictly later session before filling; re-verified idempotent.

nodes.label: paper_nav Table
nodes.rationale: The ground truth for M3's session count - 60 rows across 3 sleeves over 20 sessions with one permanent hole at 2026-07-30. Re-derived from it 2026-08-13 after HANDOFF's stated counts went stale and self-contradicted.

nodes.label: alpaca_keys.env
nodes.rationale: Project root, gitignored via the existing *_keys.env pattern (confirmed with git check-ignore -v), never committed. Holds per-sleeve E_SIX / E_EIGHTEEN_VIX_TS / M_TEN_ONE key+secret pairs plus a shared paper base URL. Claude never sees the values - creating the accounts and generating keys was explicitly Evan's step.

nodes.label: _note_vintage()
nodes.rationale: Lives in scripts/run_e8_squeeze.py, the shared data layer 31 files import (30 experiment runners plus the standing proof script), 28 of them naming cache_fetch itself. Now RAISES instead of printing - a warning nobody reads is not a guard. An earlier version could not arithmetically fire (record Appendix EM) and three call sites SWALLOWED the refusal until 2026-08-13.

nodes.label: StaleCacheError
nodes.rationale: Raised rather than printed so a stale or mixed-vintage cache stops the run. Expected to fire immediately and by design - this is not a bug.

nodes.label: cache_fetch()
nodes.rationale: The guard's ONLY caller, and the reason a cache refresh is not a one-liner: it refetches only on a MISS for the tickers the running script happens to name, so re-running one script just replaces the old mixed vintage with a new one.

nodes.label: .e8e9_cache Price Cache
nodes.rationale: Holds 5 vintages spanning 2026-07-09 to 2026-08-04. As of 2026-08-13 ALL 5 are stale - the newest included, at 9 calendar days against a 5-day tolerance - so there is no subset worth keeping. Refreshing means deleting every price-series *.json (181 files, by hand) and re-running every consumer in one sitting. No refresh tool exists and none should be built. The *_div / *_earn / index side-files carry no bar date, are invisible to the guard by design, and are not refreshed.

nodes.label: scripts/run_e8_squeeze.py (Shared Data Layer)
nodes.rationale: Accidentally the project's shared data layer: 31 files import it, 28 naming cache_fetch. It also exports UNIV, residual_series and BETA_N, which is how the live loop ends up importing it transitively without ever touching the cache.

nodes.label: SWING_ALLOW_STALE_CACHE Override
nodes.rationale: Strict =1 only, so 'true'/'yes' silently do nothing and the run still raises. Deliberate: an override that disables a correctness guard must fail closed.

nodes.label: SWING_MAX_CACHE_STALE_DAYS Tolerance
nodes.rationale: Default 5 calendar days. All 5 cache vintages currently exceed it.

nodes.label: Mixed-Vintage Cache Hazard
nodes.rationale: The concrete failure the guard prevents: a run mixing SPY (07-09) with the 142-name universe (08-04) would quietly annualize strategy CAGR over 3165 sessions and the benchmark over 3147 - a silently wrong comparison, not a crash.

nodes.label: Live Loop Unaffected by the Cache Guard (Right for the Wrong Reason)
nodes.rationale: The live M3 loop IS unaffected, but not for the reason HANDOFF used to give. It DOES import the module transitively on every run (daily_swing_paper.py:64 -> run_e10_earnings_drift:27; :65 -> run_c1_residual_reversal:29); it pulls only UNIV, residual_series and BETA_N, none of which call cache_fetch, the guard's only caller. The earlier claim 'daily_swing_paper.py does not import that module' was false - the conclusion was right for the wrong reason (record EO).
nodes.norm_label: live loop unaffected by the cache guard (right for the wrong reason)

nodes.label: scripts/run_e10_earnings_drift.py
nodes.rationale: One of the two transitive import hops from the live loop into the shared data layer (daily_swing_paper.py:64 -> run_e10_earnings_drift:27).

nodes.label: scripts/run_c1_residual_reversal.py
nodes.rationale: The second transitive import hop (daily_swing_paper.py:65 -> run_c1_residual_reversal:29); also supplies the residual_series FF3 machinery the m10_1_nagel sleeve reuses for implementation-fidelity.

nodes.label: swing.db
nodes.rationale: The project's own SQLite store for prices, positions, NAV, results and logs - 89,666 bar rows from the M0.3 backfill. Kept separate from Trading's DB by the scope guard; live-fetch research runners never write to it.

nodes.label: Trading price_cache (Split-Adjusted, Dividend-UNadjusted)
nodes.rationale: Read-only from this project, opened with SQLite URI mode=ro. Rejected as this project's price source at M0.2: it has no high/low/open series (only close+volume+flags) so IBS is uncomputable from it, and it lacks DIA/IWM and all country ETFs. The split-adjusted / dividend-UNadjusted convention must be stated in every consumer's header.

nodes.label: swing_bot/prices.py
nodes.rationale: The M0.2 decision: own yfinance OHLCV fetcher into swing.db with auto_adjust=False, chosen over reusing Trading's price_cache. Fetch now retries on a (2,5,15)s ladder (audit finding #8).

nodes.label: swing_bot/universe.py (Frozen 29-ETF Universe)
nodes.rationale: 4 broad US + 11 SPDR sectors + 14 country/regional, each with a verified first-bar date and a one-line inclusion reason. Frozen by dated decision - changes require a new one. Flagged at freeze time: country-ETF IBS has a stale-NAV/overnight mechanism distinct from US-index IBS, so E1 reports per-group.

nodes.label: swing_bot/coverage_gate.py
nodes.rationale: Refuses to emit signals unless 100% of the universe has a bar for the as-of date - the universe is tiny, so no partial-coverage tolerance is needed. Its done-check is adversarial: it must exit nonzero on truncated fixture data. It found 19 real zero-range bars in XLRE's first 5 months, which forced E1 to skip high==low days (IBS div-by-zero).

nodes.label: swing_bot/test_frozen.py Frozen Tripwire
nodes.rationale: The project's required done-check: 12 pinned refs at d=+/-0.0000pp plus 17 invariants, printing 'FROZEN TESTS: GREEN (all d=0)'. Green continuously since 2026-07-09. Ported from Trading's frozen-regression pattern; run after ANY change to swing_bot/ or daily_swing_paper.py.

nodes.label: docs/CAPSTONE_program_synthesis.md
nodes.rationale: The standing full-program synthesis: methodology-as-deliverable, the family/attempt ledger, the structural WHY, and the one uncatchable anomaly. Deliberately reframed 2026-07-14 from 'COMPLETE / method space exhausted' to 'ONGOING', adding a section 8 open frontier - the what-might-work half of the report.

nodes.label: docs/M12_constraint_relaxation_plan.md
nodes.rationale: Evan's 2026-08-03 next direction was RELAX A CONSTRAINT rather than hunt a 38th rule inside the same box; this plan is where that lives. HANDOFF used to point at a nonexistent 'options block below' instead (audit #4 F10).

nodes.label: Full Method Survey (~90 Methods, 8 Families)
nodes.rationale: Eight parallel research agents graded ~90 primary-source methods. Its payload is the RECONCILIATION: the literature's top 'untested' ideas were already killed here (sector momentum E14, turn-of-month E13, earnings premium E15, raw weekly reversal E16, dividend capture E20). What survived reconciliation was seven candidates, all carrying strong FAIL priors. Tally deliberately unchanged - a survey is research, not a run.

nodes.label: Central DST-Aware Timestamp Convention
nodes.rationale: Record/doc stamps are Central and DST-AWARE: read the offset from `date` and label by the number (UTC-6 -> CST, UTC-5 -> CDT). Set 2026-07-11 after earlier entries were mislabeled UTC-as-local; made DST-aware 2026-07-19. An earlier version hardcoded 'CST (UTC-5)', which is self-contradictory, corrected 2026-07-28 by audit #7.

nodes.label: Alpaca Paper Account Decision (RESOLVED)
nodes.rationale: RESOLVED 2026-07-15: 3 NEW dedicated paper accounts, $1,000 each, one per sleeve - none of Trading's ~3, so order flow never mixes across the two projects. All 3 verified 200 OK / ACTIVE / distinct account numbers, read-only, no orders. It sat unstruck under BLOCKED-ON-EVAN for 4 weeks before being corrected 2026-08-13 (record EO).

nodes.label: Gap: No Total-Return (Dividend-Adjusted) Data Path
nodes.rationale: Logged by X8: dividend-UNadjusted prices materially understate coupon/dividend-heavy instruments like TLT, so they cannot be tested fairly. Declared as a bias rather than papered over.

nodes.label: docs/Project Record - Full Chronological History.md
nodes.rationale: Append-only chronological record and the ground truth when anything disagrees; HANDOFF is the only live snapshot. For historical fact the record beats every snapshot.

nodes.label: Do & Faff (2010) - Pairs-Trading Decay
nodes.rationale: Gatev's pairs edge decayed to ~nil post-2002. Pre-declared as X9's FAVORED prior so a FAIL could not be dressed up as a surprise; X9 then reproduced it independently on this project's data.

nodes.label: Gatev Distance Method (Pairs Trading)
nodes.rationale: Adopted wholesale at Gatev's PUBLISHED defaults (252/63/K=3/2-sigma/20-stop) precisely so nothing was fit here. 29 ETFs, 6,927 sessions, 5 bps per side PER LEG = ~20 bps a round trip.

nodes.label: Boehmer-Huszar-Jordan - Short-Interest Anomaly
nodes.rationale: Confirmed alive on the modern tape by X2: long-short spread +18.39%, high-DTC leg -2.63% (most-shorted mega-caps underperform SPY ~15pp/yr). The alpha sits entirely on the non-deployable SHORT leg - and X2b then showed even that is a frictionless mirage.

nodes.label: PRD Objective: Either a Validated Strategy or a Documented Null
nodes.rationale: Exactly one of two results must stand on the record: a forward-paper-validated OOS swing strategy, OR a documented proof that the retail-EOD / K=1-3 / liquidity-floored corner holds no robust edge. Both are reached only through pre-registered falsification - the rigor loop is as much the deliverable as any strategy. Written for two readers at once: Evan as a small-capital trader, and a college-application reader auditing the engineering process.
nodes.norm_label: prd objective: either a validated strategy or a documented null

nodes.label: Scope Guard: Never Modify the Trading Repo
nodes.rationale: Evan's 2026-07-08 decision. Never modify anything in D:\ClaudeCode\Trading (repo or DB) from this project; price_cache is READ-ONLY from here; never run backtests concurrently with Trading's; paper trading only, no real-money order paths, period. Testable rather than aspirational: Trading's git status stays clean of our fingerprints and no writer here opens its DB in write mode. If a task seems to require breaking it, STOP and report.
nodes.norm_label: scope guard: never modify the trading repo

nodes.label: Success Criteria Checklist (PRD Section 3)
nodes.rationale: 5 of 10 boxes ticked 2026-08-06 (audit #3) - every one had already been satisfied and none had ever been marked, so the file read as 0/10 done. Ticks carry checkable evidence (commit hashes and timestamps), not assertions. The remaining 5 stay OPEN and untickd: the >=20-unattended-day run has holes, and the three LLM-overlay/control criteria belong to the shelved e1_control/e1_llm_veto framing, so they are stale rather than done.

nodes.label: D1 Dual-Bar Verdict Protocol
nodes.rationale: Approved by Evan 2026-07-12 (record Appendix AW) as a dated goal AMENDMENT - gate numbers change only by a new dated Evan decision. Adds a pre-registered risk-adjusted tier alongside the unchanged high-return one, because running overlay candidates under the primary bar alone is theater: overlays cannot clear PASS-HR at all. Every prereg fixes ALL THREE labels before running. PASS-RA does not authorize live capital by itself - it only makes a forward-paper candidate.

nodes.label: PASS-HR (High-Return) Gate
nodes.rationale: Net CAGR >= 15% AND maxDD <= 60% in the 2000-2013 gate window, confirmed in 2014->end. The unchanged primary bar. Zero clean passes in the whole program: M10-1 cleared it but is IN-SAMPLE-COMPOSED, and E16 cleared the return leg once at 16.76% CAGR only to breach the DD ceiling at 65.9%.

nodes.label: PASS-RA (Risk-Adjusted) Gate
nodes.rationale: Net Sharpe >= 0.80 in the gate window AND strictly above SPY buy-hold's in BOTH windows AND positive net CAGR in both. Exactly one pass in the program - E18's VIX/VIX3M<1 gate - and it is flagged WEAK because the 2006-13 window has one crash, so the pass largely equals dodging 2008.

nodes.label: Modified-Window PROMISING Cap
nodes.rationale: Short-window data breaks the D1 gate protocol - FINRA SI starts 2021, Reg SHO 2009, crypto ~2015 - so the 2000-2013 hostile-regime gate is unusable there. Rule adopted for M9: each prereg fixes a modified window a priori, discloses the reduced confidence, and CAPS the best achievable verdict at 'PROMISING - needs forward confirmation'. Only full-window experiments can claim D1 tiers.

nodes.label: docs/prereg_TEMPLATE.md
nodes.rationale: The standing template every future prereg copies, folding the research-batch process findings into fixed [STANDING] sections: tiered costs, the decomposition ladder, the time-stop baseline, capped-Kelly sizing, plus D1 dual-bar, asymmetric framing, prereg-before-code hash, tripwire-GREEN done-check, the modified-window cap, and LLM-forward-only.

nodes.label: Pre-Registration-Before-Code Ordering Rule
nodes.rationale: Sacred and provable forever from git log: if backtest-engine code exists before the prereg doc is committed, the project's core claim is dead. When in doubt, commit the doc first. Verified for E1 (prereg 8963e49 at 12:17:29 predates backtest.py 415c527 at 12:24:54, 7m25s later) and E2 (865c09e predates 6ef2b2a the same day). Several later preregs are doc-only commits that predate their runners.

nodes.label: Rung A/B/C Execution-vs-Signal Decomposition Ladder
nodes.rationale: Required in every results doc: Rung A frictionless close-to-close 0 bps, Rung B next-open 0 bps, Rung C next-open plus costs (the graded rung). It separates SIGNAL-DEAD (fails A) from GAP-DWELLER (dies A->B) from COST-GATED (dies B->C), which is what turned a flat 'null' into two named killers.

nodes.label: Time-Stop-Only Baseline Requirement
nodes.rationale: Every strategy reports a time-stop-only exit arm as the honest baseline, and any price-stop variant must BEAT it. C3 justified the rule: its time-stop arm beat the channel exit 6.19% vs 3.62% - the 10-day-low exit was a whipsaw tax, not risk control.

nodes.label: Tiered Cost Model + Liquidity Floor Formalization
nodes.rationale: 1 bp/side broad ETFs, 5 bps/side single stocks and sector ETFs, 15-25 bps or exclude below the floor; liquidity floor formalized as ADV >= $5M AND price >= $5; participation cap declared non-binding at this AUM; a 15 bps/side stress leg reported alongside. The stress leg does real work - it broke M10-1, C1 and X3.
nodes.norm_label: tiered cost model + liquidity floor formalization

nodes.label: Capped Fractional-Kelly Sizing Defaults
nodes.rationale: Capped fractional-Kelly (lambda <= 1/2), fixed-risk r = 1-2%/trade, anti-martingale only, no leverage, with lambda and r frozen per prereg. Engine gotcha behind it: E2 sized on initial capital rather than current NAV and a K=1 3x run sent NAV negative - future engines size on current NAV.

nodes.label: Asymmetric-Falsification Framing
nodes.rationale: On the survivor universe only a FAIL is clean - a PASS is uninterpretable because survivorship flatters exactly the trades the strategy makes. It is why C1's in-window passes were declared UNINTERPRETABLE and why every stock experiment inherits E3's framing. ETF experiments are interpretable in both directions.

nodes.label: LLM Overlays Are Forward-Only (Training-Cutoff Look-Ahead)
nodes.rationale: LLM overlays cannot be backtested honestly, period: any LLM scoring historical dates is partly RECALLING outcomes (Profit Mirage: 50-72% post-cutoff decay; Levy 2026). So the whole LLM shortlist is forward-only treatment arms on the M3 live-paper control, never backtests. Non-negotiable gates when it runs: pinned model ID+version (an upgrade = re-prereg), immutable overlay_log, ticker anonymization, and the tripwire pinned on DETERMINISTIC REPLAY of the log rather than a live model call.

nodes.label: M0 - Foundations
nodes.rationale: Infrastructure before science (council 5/5): git repo, venv, verified data access, frozen ETF universe, coverage gate, tripwire harness. Done - all 5 tasks.

nodes.label: M1 - Pre-Registration & Ablation
nodes.rationale: Ordered before M2 so thresholds provably precede results: power calc, then the prereg doc commit, then the fill-timing ablation.

nodes.label: M2 - E1 Backtest
nodes.rationale: Purpose-built ~200-line engine rather than adapting Trading's factor_backtest.py, which has monthly top-N economics baked in. Ends at a BLOCKED-ON-EVAN gate; E1 FAILED and Evan redefined the goal instead.

nodes.label: M2b - E2 Leveraged-ETF IBS (High-Return Arm)
nodes.rationale: Added by Evan's 2026-07-09 goal redefinition. First high-return arm chosen because E1b had proved the IBS edge persists OOS in exactly the underlyings the leveraged funds wrap.

nodes.label: M2c - E3 Concentrated Mega-Cap Stocks
nodes.rationale: Universe defined by a dollar-volume floor, explicitly NOT by picking today's winners; survivorship caveat mandatory in every result; signal family chosen only after E2's evidence.

nodes.label: M2d - Rotation Family (E4/E5/E6)
nodes.rationale: 3x MA rotation PASSED then failed the regime test; the de-leveraged 1x version (E6) is the family's one surviving output - a robust drawdown overlay.

nodes.label: M2e - E7 International Validation
nodes.rationale: Exists because US backtest data is EXHAUSTED - its two crash regimes have already been used to judge the rotation family, so further US tweaks are hindsight-contaminated. Non-US indices supply genuinely unseen independent regimes, above all the 1990s-2000s Japan secular bear, the most hostile trend-rotation environment in modern history. The honest way to test a high-return idea without live paper.

nodes.label: M3 - Live Paper (Gated)
nodes.rationale: RUNNING since 2026-07-15; the row's figures are a deliberately unrewritten 2026-08-11 status stamp (18 sessions, 5 executed transactions, task S4U), with 20 sessions through 2026-08-12 noted as of 2026-08-13. It had said 'ready to run (no orders placed yet)' for 18 live sessions before audit #4 F12 corrected it. Nothing goes live on an unvalidated edge - this milestone is the gate.

nodes.label: M4 - Overlay Readout (Gated on Pre-Registered N)
nodes.rationale: Evaluate veto vs control at the pre-registered point, NOT before however tempting interim numbers look; then continue, add the cascade arm, or KILL per prereg. If N is arriving too slowly to ever read out, that is reported honestly as the result.
nodes.norm_label: m4 - overlay readout (gated on pre-registered n)

nodes.label: M5 - Expansion (Gated on M3 Stable)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately last: breadth only after one strategy survives contact. Deferred ideas only, one at a time, each with its own prereg section.

nodes.label: M6 - Portfolio Packaging
nodes.rationale: README -> findings doc, record HTML twin, git tag: make the repo readable cold. Repo published public at github.com/Evan-Daruwalla/Swing-Trading-Project.

nodes.label: M7 - Catalog Arc E13-E17
nodes.rationale: After 0/13, the catalog brief identified exactly five ideas that are genuinely untested here, peer-reviewed, and EOD-codifiable at retail scale. Honest prior stated up front: none plausibly clears 15% CAGR, three plausibly clear a risk-adjusted bar - which is why D1 exists. Outcome: E13-E16 all FAIL both tiers, E17 BLOCKED-ON-DATA, zero PASS-RA survivors.

nodes.label: M7b - Data-Type Arc E18-E20
nodes.rationale: The data-type brief found six free non-OHLCV data types but they skew to regime gates and overlays, not return engines - only three carried enough merit to pre-register. CLOSED 2026-07-13; produced the program's only PASS-RA (E18's VIX-TS gate, weak).

nodes.label: M8 - Full-Method-Survey Candidates C1-C7
nodes.rationale: Explicitly lower-expected-value than M7/M7b: all seven carry strong FAIL priors, four are overlays that cannot clear PASS-HR at all, one is an intentional kill-shot. It exists to either find a second tier-pass or extend the terminal claim from 'the catalog space is exhausted' to 'the entire documented swing-method space is exhausted'. All seven failed every tier - and the sweep produced the program's most TEMPTING numbers (C1/C7/C4), which the pre-registered bars killed anyway: the discipline demonstrating itself.

nodes.label: M9 - Research-Batch-2 Arc X1-X6 + Discipline Adoptions
nodes.rationale: Produced process upgrades that bind every future prereg, five new candidates, and two structural findings that changed experiment DESIGN itself - the modified-window cap and LLM-forward-only. Tasks 43-44 are ordered first precisely because they upgrade every later experiment.
nodes.norm_label: m9 - research-batch-2 arc x1-x6 + discipline adoptions

nodes.label: M10 - Evidence-Synthesis Arc: State-Conditioned Strategies
nodes.rationale: Evan asked whether the accumulated evidence - not a new signal - could be composed into something clearing both tiers. Because it is a synthesis over prior results it carries a data-snooping cap unique to M10: any pass is IN-SAMPLE-COMPOSED, so 'forward paper REQUIRED', never clean or live. Lasting outputs: the fixed-weight impossibility proof, the first (in-sample) PASS-HR, and the E2 mirage closed.

nodes.label: M11 - Algorithmic Chart-Pattern Detection
nodes.rationale: The one classical mechanism family never tested here: every prior attempt trades a NUMBER, none trades SHAPE. Rule-based, not LLM/ML, per Evan. It fits every constraint and, being price-only with no data wall, is full-window D1-reachable - it can claim a true tier, unlike every post-2000 experiment. Honest prior FAIL stated before any run. Running it is lower-expected-value than M7/M8, and that is the point: it closes the last obvious gap in 'trying everything'. Its heading contradicted the file's own milestone row for 4 weeks (corrected by audit #4 F12).

nodes.label: M12 - Constraint-Relaxation Factorial
nodes.rationale: RUN 2026-08-03 (this row read 'PLANNED, NOT RUN' for 10 days; corrected 2026-08-13, record EO). The search closed having falsified the space CONDITIONED ON K=1-3 and days-to-weeks holds, but never tested WHICH constraint binds. Controlled 2x2: horizon (10 vs 63 sessions) x concentration (K=3 vs K=20), with 12-1 cross-sectional momentum held constant because the project already owns both endpoints. The original values stay as baseline cell 1, so the old box is measured head-to-head. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - it widens what may be TESTED, not what may be DEPLOYED.

nodes.label: E1 - ETF IBS Mean Reversion
nodes.rationale: The council-selected first experiment and the one that established the pattern. FAIL: Sharpe 0.23, maxDD 36%, no tuning. Cost-fragile; country ETFs drag; post-2021 decay. A FAIL honestly recorded is a deliverable, not a setback.

nodes.label: E2 - Leveraged-ETF IBS
nodes.rationale: FAIL on the holdout: n=351 PASS, expectancy +31bps PASS, but CAGR 7.98% vs the 15% bar and maxDD 60.6% vs the 60% ceiling. Train 19.6% -> holdout 7.98%, the same OOS decay as E1b. The c2c (non-executable) run would have PASSED at 18.15%. Prereg section 7's stop was EXECUTED: no E2b/E1c/execution variants without a new dated Evan decision - the IBS family was shelved rather than retried.

nodes.label: E3 - Concentrated Mega-Cap Stock Momentum
nodes.rationale: FAIL clean: gate CAGR 6.27% vs 15%, and momentum UNDERPERFORMED equal-weight buy-hold of its own survivor universe in every window (2014-26: 4.79% vs 14.94%). Closed the third of the three high-return routes and supplies the 39-name survivor universe every later stock experiment inherits.

nodes.label: E7 - International Validation
nodes.rationale: Both arms FAIL. Arm 1 downgraded E6 to market-dependent (works 3/5 markets); Arm 2's a-priori-vol-gated 3x rotation failed every gate (mean CAGR 4.55%, 83-97% DDs, HSI 3x mathematically wiped out by the 1987 crash). The 30% vol threshold was fixed from first principles (3x x 30% ~ 90% position vol as a prudence ceiling), NOT fit to any crash. Local-index returns are a currency-neutral mechanics test; price indices understate return by dividends, flagged.

nodes.label: E13 - Turn-of-the-Month Overlay
nodes.rationale: FAIL both tiers (gate CAGR 1.41%, Sharpe 0.20) at 19.1% time in market. EX-DECOMP later reclassified it as COST-GATED, not signal-dead: a real calendar edge killed by turnover.

nodes.label: E14 - Diversified Sector Momentum
nodes.rationale: Fully survivorship-CLEAN, so a PASS would have been the program's first interpretable pass of any tier. Instead the cleanest negative: FAIL both tiers, momentum lost to equal-weight buy-hold of the SAME sectors in every window. EX-DECOMP found it is the only genuinely SIGNAL-DEAD member of the retrofit set.

nodes.label: E15 - Earnings-Announcement Premium
nodes.rationale: FAIL clean (gate CAGR 6.36%, Sharpe 0.49). PEAD's decayed twin - beat both benchmarks in 2000-13 then faded post-2014. Disclosed biases: survivor universe plus a mild but real scheduled-date lookahead, since date changes correlate with bad news.

nodes.label: E16 - Cross-Sectional Weekly Reversal
nodes.rationale: The notable FAIL: gate CAGR 16.76% cleared the 15% return bar for the first time ever, but on 65.9% drawdown against a 60% ceiling, Sharpe 0.61. The disclosed counter-evidence held - the headline is the expected survivorship artifact of dip-buying survivors. Its 65.9% DD is exactly what C1's residual construction was designed to fix.

nodes.label: E17 - Days-to-Cover (BLOCKED-ON-DATA)
nodes.rationale: Closed WITHOUT a prereg via the probe-first pattern: no free exchange-listed short-interest history (FINRA free bulk download is OTC-only pre-June-2021). Confirmed independently by the full-method survey. Later partly unblocked as X2.

nodes.label: E18 - Regime-Gate Bake-Off
nodes.rationale: Four a-priori risk-on/off gates judged head-to-head as drawdown overlays against the existing 200-DMA benchmark. No gate beat the plain 200-DMA on the robust both-windows criterion - but the VIX/VIX3M<1 arm cleared PASS-RA, the program's first tier-pass, flagged WEAK. HY-OAS arm INCONCLUSIVE (FRED free data only ~2023+). An overlay test where PASS-RA is the only reachable tier: without D1 the task would have been pointless.

nodes.label: E19 - Insider Opportunistic-Buy Drift
nodes.rationale: The heaviest ingestion the project attempted (104,496 Form-4s, 39/39 CIKs) and the program's 8th family. FAIL clean and robust: underperforms SPY on CAGR AND Sharpe in BOTH windows. Data was heavily transactionCode-'P' contaminated (BAC alone = 44% of P-buys, including $0.01 1-share artifacts) and the CMP classifier passed 95% through - falsifying the prior prediction that routine filings would absorb it - but a post-hoc de-junk sensitivity cutting entries 6,119->2,675 left the verdict unchanged, so the FAIL is a clean falsification, not a contamination artifact.

nodes.label: E20 - Dividend-Capture Falsification
nodes.rationale: FAIL both tiers (gate CAGR 0.62%). A real but tiny ex-date edge (+0.10%/trade, 57.7% win rate) that does not compound, goes negative post-2014, and is pre-tax. The one place the dividend-UNADJUSTED convention is finally CORRECT for the measurement.

nodes.label: C1 - Short-Term Residual Reversal
nodes.rationale: The program's CLOSEST-EVER high-return near-miss: gate 19.08% CAGR / DD 57.7% clears BOTH PASS-HR legs in-window, a first - it beats E16's return and fixes its drawdown by stripping the factor-driven variance. But the secondary collapses to 2.92% (dead post-2014), 15bps kills it, and survivorship upper-bounds the gate anyway, so the in-window pass is UNINTERPRETABLE. Its residual_series machinery is reused verbatim by the m10_1_nagel live sleeve.

nodes.label: C2 - Dividend-Initiation Drift
nodes.rationale: Closed BLOCKED-BY-DESIGN on the probe, no prereg or runner: only THREE first-ever in-window initiations in 26 years among the 39 survivors (MSFT 2003, ORCL 2009, CSCO 2011; AAPL-2012 is a resumption). n=3 cannot clear any event floor. Distinct from the killed E20, which tested dividend CAPTURE around ex-dates on ETFs.

nodes.label: C3 - Consolidated Volatility-Breakout Kill-Shot
nodes.rationale: Donchian, Bollinger-squeeze, ATR-channel and Keltner deliberately COLLAPSED into ONE spec to avoid multiple-testing snooping, and pre-registered as an honest kill-shot rather than a hopeful engine. FAIL as predicted (gate 3.62%/Sh 0.37). Key finding: the time-stop-only arm BEATS the channel exit - the 10-day-low exit is a whipsaw tax. Third of three breakout-family kills.

nodes.label: C4 - Vol-Targeting Sizing Overlay
nodes.rationale: FAIL on the bar but a REAL drawdown cutter: managed beats base Sharpe in both windows on both bases (E6 gate DD 53.7->25.1%; E18 sec 43.6->27.0%, Sh 0.82->0.94), yet best gate Sharpe 0.77 < 0.80 - not tuned. The natural deployment shape if the E6/E18 forward-paper candidate ever goes live.

nodes.label: C5 - Reg SHO Short-Volume Drift
nodes.rationale: Identified as the SAME signal as M9's X3 and deliberately not run separately - covered there rather than double-counted as an attempt.

nodes.label: C6 - Even-Week FOMC-Cycle Overlay
nodes.rationale: The cleanest decay exhibit yet: the gate replicates the published result EXACTLY (+5.62bps/day even vs -3.15 odd) and then INVERTS post-2014 (+3.69 vs +6.60) - it died at publication. Overlay gate Sharpe 0.34; 1,585 toggles go negative at 15bps. Calendar compiled from federalreserve.gov primary sources. Third decayed-calendar exhibit with E13 and E15.

nodes.label: C7 - SVXY Short-Vol Carry Gated by VIX Term Structure
nodes.rationale: FAIL despite the program's highest-ever full-window CAGR (26.45%): it loses Sharpe to SPY 0.76 vs 0.82 against a pre-committed CAGR-AND-Sharpe bar, and the headline is an artifact of the DEAD -1x instrument (era split 47.33%/0.99 pre-2018 vs 13.18%/0.55 on today's -0.5x SVXY). The VIX-TS gate dodged Volmageddon by ONE session - effective N=1 luck, not safety. A hard drawdown kill-switch was mandatory in the prereg precisely because Volmageddon cut short-vol ETPs >90% in one session.
nodes.norm_label: c7 - svxy short-vol carry gated by vix term structure

nodes.label: X1 - Conditional Volatility Targeting (E6 x E18)
nodes.rationale: FAIL - H1 rejected, null survives, CONFIRMS E18: no vol gate beats the plain 200-DMA. The mechanism of the failure is instructive: conditioning on vol keeps it invested 89% of the time (vs E6's 70%), so it barely de-risks at all. Labeled descriptive because there are only ~3-5 independent stress episodes in the whole sample.
nodes.norm_label: x1 - conditional volatility targeting (e6 x e18)

nodes.label: X2 - FINRA Days-to-Cover
nodes.rationale: Data proved better than assumed (FINRA REST API, no auth, history to 2017-12-29 not 2021, precomputed DTC). FAIL on the deployable long-only leg: 13.32% CAGR beats SPY's 12.53% but loses Sharpe 0.60<0.71 against the pre-committed CAGR-AND-Sharpe bar. PAYLOAD: the anomaly is real and correctly signed, but the alpha sits ENTIRELY on the non-deployable SHORT leg - no fractional shorting at $100-1,000 - exactly as the prereg predicted a priori. The program's strongest real anomaly is one it structurally cannot trade. Rebalanced on PUBLICATION date because using settlement date is look-ahead.

nodes.label: X3 - Reg SHO Short-Volume-Ratio Drift
nodes.rationale: FAIL - the existence spread is +1.24%/Sh 0.16, essentially ZERO signal: executed short volume is market-maker hedging noise, the clean contrast to X2's real +18.39% short-INTEREST spread. Full ingest 4,260 sessions 2009-08 -> 2026-07, 39/39 coverage, through a schema break at 2011-02-28 and a Cloudflare browser-UA fix. Completes the informed-positioning family.

nodes.label: X4 - MOC Close-Entry Probe (BLOCKED)
nodes.rationale: The only fill positioned to capture the ~54% overnight component. The backtest upper bound already exists (E2's c2c would have PASSED) - what is untested is IMPLEMENTATION, so step 1 is a broker probe, not a backtest. Signal must come from a frozen 15:50 snapshot because using the 16:00 close for a 15:50 order is look-ahead. Blocked on the Alpaca account and an intraday feed.

nodes.label: X5 - Analyst Recommendation-Change Drift
nodes.rationale: BLOCKED-ON-EVAN on a ~$22 FMP Starter month. The cheapest clean event-driven unblock because upgrades/downgrades are EVENT-DATED, which sidesteps the point-in-time consensus trap that gates estimate-revision drift. Prior FAIL: the buy side is the documented-weak side and it decayed post-Reg-FD. Free ratings are look-ahead, so this cannot be faked.

nodes.label: X6 - BTC/ETH Time-Series Trend Pilot
nodes.rationale: FAIL, first crypto domain. Gate 29.61% CAGR CRUSHES HODL's 4.34%, but secondary Sharpe 0.76 < HODL 1.01 in the bull -> fails the beat-HODL-BOTH-windows bar (15% CAGR alone is trivial in crypto, hence the extra requirement). Cost-robust: 33 toggles in 5 years, so the '25 bps kills it' worry was wrong for a slow overlay. Same lesson as equity E6 - MA trend is drawdown control (82%->61% DD), not a return enhancer in bulls. A 100d sensitivity looked better but the verdict was NOT switched. Universe fixed to BTC+ETH to kill survivorship and the liquidity wall; UTC-00:00 bars have no gap by construction.

nodes.label: M10-1 - Nagel Switch (VIX-Regime State-Switch)
nodes.rationale: The program's FIRST PASS-HR - both windows clear >=15% CAGR and <=60% DD - and explicitly NOT a win by the program's own discipline: composed after 31 results, survivor-flattered, gate DD clears by 0.05 pp, breaks at VIX>18 and at 15 bps, fails PASS-RA. The switch is causal rather than fit because Nagel (2012) makes reversal alpha liquidity-provision compensation that scales with VIX. Fixed a carry-forward mark-to-market bug (past-only, no look-ahead) that had shown a spurious -100% NAV.

nodes.label: M10-2 - Gap-Amortized Stress IBS
nodes.rationale: FAIL with the payload IN the fail: the 5-day hold neutralized the overnight gap (c2c 3.18% ~ next-open 2.99%), isolating the reversion's gap-free economics - catastrophic in the gate at 83.3% DD. This PERMANENTLY closes the E2 c2c 18.15% mirage: the gap was hiding the DRAWDOWN (2x long into 2000-02/2008 cascades), not alpha. It also sharpens M10-1 - unlevered cross-sectional reversal passes, 2x index MR is an 83%-DD engine, so M10-1's pass is a cross-sectional-SURVIVOR effect, not a general stress-reversion edge.

nodes.label: EX-DECOMP - Decomposition-Ladder Retrofit
nodes.rationale: A diagnostic with no D1 verdict, so the attempt tally is unchanged. Rung A was obtained with ZERO execution-logic edits via an open:=prior-close feed wrapper plus one additive return hook per runner, and regression-checked (Rung C reproduces the recorded FAILs). The PRD's own 'most will be SIGNAL-DEAD' expectation was WRONG - only E14 is. Payload: two recurring killers, the overnight gap and cost/turnover, not one flat null - a stronger terminal statement.

nodes.label: e1_control Sleeve (Superseded)
nodes.rationale: The pure-mechanical control arm of the original M3 design, written in the M0 era. Died with E1 in M2b - it no longer corresponds to anything worth forward-testing, and M3 deployed three real mechanical sleeves instead. Its design requirement survives conceptually: control orders computed and finalized BEFORE any overlay call, enforced by a runtime assertion.

nodes.label: e1_llm_veto Sleeve (Superseded / Not Built)
nodes.rationale: Evan's 2026-07-08 decision kept LLM overlays LIVE-ACTING from day one, overriding the council's power-based drop: the overlay trades immediately, but statistical CONCLUSIONS wait for the pre-registered N. NOT BUILT - the spec was superseded when E1 failed. Evan's go and the Alpaca accounts are no longer blockers; an overlay arm now needs its own prereg (corrected 2026-08-13, record EO).

nodes.label: overlay_log Table
nodes.rationale: Trading's overlay-log schema with UNIQUE(date,ticker). Must be immutable, and the frozen tripwire is pinned on DETERMINISTIC REPLAY of this log rather than on a live model call - otherwise the tripwire measures the model's mood, not the code.

nodes.label: Fixed-Weight Blend Impossibility Proof
nodes.rationale: The load-bearing negative from M10's multi-agent design panel: a fixed-weight blend of the surviving sleeves CANNOT clear PASS-HR, because the 2000-13 gate needs C1-reversal weight >= 0.66 while the 2014-> secondary needs <= 0.29 - an arithmetic contradiction. The only escape is state-conditioning on a causal variable, which is what motivated M10-1.

nodes.label: M10 In-Sample-Composed Cap
nodes.rationale: A data-snooping cap unique to M10: because the arc composes over 31 prior results, ANY pass is IN-SAMPLE-COMPOSED and is recorded as 'PROMISING / forward paper REQUIRED', never clean or deployable. It is what keeps the program's only PASS-HR from being claimed as a win.

nodes.label: Alpaca Order Constraints (DAY-TIF, Market-Notional, No Fractional Shorting)
nodes.rationale: CORRECTED 2026-08-11 (audit #4 F12): Alpaca REJECTS notional+limit, so the live loop's canonical fractional order is market-notional DAY - Appendix BO's earlier claim did not survive contact with the API. Binding constraints: TIF=DAY only (no GTC, so exits are re-armed daily or software-managed) and no fractional shorting (long-only unless whole shares). PDT fields were removed from the API 2026-07-06 and must not be read. Paper fills are simulated at the quoted half-spread with no price improvement, slippage, or depth check.
nodes.norm_label: alpaca order constraints (day-tif, market-notional, no fractional shorting)

nodes.label: 39-Name Survivor Large-Cap Universe
nodes.rationale: Inherited from E3 by every later stock experiment (E10, E15, E16, E19, C1, C5, M11, X2, X3), and the reason they all carry asymmetric-falsification framing. Its EW-39 equal-weight buy-hold doubles as the survivorship-clean benchmark that several candidates lose to.

nodes.label: 142-Name Frozen M12 Universe
nodes.rationale: The M12 universe open decision (39-name existing / ~100 expanded / Trading's 12,486 read-only) is CLOSED - frozen at 142 names (record DT). Its 2026-08-04 cache vintage is one half of the mixed-vintage hazard the stale-cache guard now blocks.

nodes.label: M12 Finding: Horizon Binds, Breadth Does Not
nodes.rationale: The 2x2's answer to 'which constraint binds': HORIZON binds, breadth does not (record DU; secondary-window numbers corrected 2026-08-04, record DV). 12-1 momentum was held constant because the project already owns both endpoints - E3 concentrated/short = FAIL, Trading's momentum_v2 top-50/monthly = validated IS +21.0% / OOS +26.5%. Diagnostic only: no cell becomes a sleeve without a separate D1-gated prereg.
nodes.norm_label: m12 finding: horizon binds, breadth does not

nodes.label: git tag search-phase-closed-v1
nodes.rationale: Commit 6e8f431 - the declared revert point for the M12 constraint relaxation, so widening the tested box is reversible rather than a one-way door.

nodes.label: $100-1,000 Capital Assumption
nodes.rationale: From Evan's 2026-07-08 brief; the $100-10,000 figure in the pasted inventory remains unconfirmed. Sizing code takes capital as a PARAMETER so this is never hard-coded. It is the constraint that makes fractionability load-bearing and that makes X2's short leg structurally untradeable.

nodes.label: K=1-3 Concentration Constraint
nodes.rationale: The survey's structural finding is that this constraint is itself a killer: K=1-3 concentration destroys diversified-decile edges, and those edges live in illiquid names the liquidity floor excludes - so 0-for-20 is what an honest retail-EOD program should produce. Relaxed to a tested variable (K=20) only under M12, and only for diagnosis.

nodes.label: 20-Day Unattended Stabilization Window
nodes.rationale: >=20 consecutive trading days unattended with misses and interventions logged HONESTLY. Still not met as a success criterion: the series has holes (the 2026-07-30 permanent gap), so the box stays untickd rather than rounded up.

nodes.label: M1.8 Fill-Timing Ablation
nodes.rationale: A simple vectorized study, deliberately NOT the backtest engine: on every historical signal compare close-to-close (the published effect), next-open (the executable loop), and the overnight-only component. It produced the number that governs the whole program - next-open keeps ~64%, so ~54% of the MR edge lives in the gap - and named which fill model M2 treats as primary.

nodes.label: E1 Power Calculation (No Return Peeking)
nodes.rationale: Counts signal days ONLY - post-signal returns are off-limits until the prereg commits, because computing them is peeking before pre-registration. States whether E1 is powerable and on what timeline.

nodes.label: Nagel (2012) - Reversal as Liquidity Provision
nodes.rationale: Cuts both ways in this project. As C1's disclosed COUNTER-evidence: reversal returns are close-anchored liquidity provision, so next-open execution bleeds the same gap that killed the IBS family. As M10-1's MECHANISM: that same alpha scales with VIX, which makes the VIX>20 switch causal rather than fit.

nodes.label: Lo, Mamaysky & Wang (2000) - Foundations of Technical Analysis
nodes.rationale: The one rigorous algorithmic pattern detector (kernel smoothing + local extrema, 10 classic patterns, US equities 1962-96). Found patterns carry modest incremental statistical information but explicitly did NOT show cost-surviving profitability - 'informative != tradeable'. Its detector definitions were adopted to pin M11's parameters externally rather than fitting them, but its two-sided kernel is NON-CAUSAL, so M11 had to build a causal substitute.
nodes.norm_label: lo, mamaysky & wang (2000) - foundations of technical analysis

nodes.label: Sullivan, Timmermann & White (1999) - Data-Snooping in Technical Rules
nodes.rationale: Technical-rule profits largely vanish under data-snooping correction plus realistic costs, out of sample. Cited as the a-priori FAIL basis for both C3 and M11.
nodes.norm_label: sullivan, timmermann & white (1999) - data-snooping in technical rules

nodes.label: Bajgrowicz & Scaillet (2012) - FDR-Corrected Technical Rules
nodes.rationale: Even low transaction costs erase technical-rule profits after false-discovery-rate correction - the offset is in-sample. Paired with Sullivan-Timmermann-White as C3's and M11's snoop-decay prior.

nodes.label: McLean & Pontiff - Post-Publication Anomaly Decay
nodes.rationale: A pattern taught publicly for decades is a published, arb-eligible signal by definition. The program's recurring explanation for the decayed-calendar exhibits (E13/E15/C6) and part of M11's stated prior.

nodes.label: Savin, Weller & Zvingelis (2007) - Head-and-Shoulders Predictability
nodes.rationale: The one piece of positive chart-pattern evidence, and it points the wrong way for this project: the H&S edge is ~5-7%/yr risk-adjusted UNDERPERFORMANCE - a SHORT signal, not profitable standalone in rising markets, working only in hedged portfolios. That is the same no-fractional-shorting wall that made X2/X2b uncapturable. M11 then measured the OPPOSITE sign on the survivor universe.

nodes.label: Moskowitz & Grinblatt (1999) - Industry Momentum
nodes.rationale: Source for E14, the program's only fully survivorship-clean experiment.

nodes.label: McConnell & Xu (2008) - Turn-of-the-Month Effect
nodes.rationale: Source for E13's 4-session turn window.

nodes.label: Frazzini & Lamont (2007) - Earnings-Announcement Premium
nodes.rationale: Source for E15's buy-5-sessions-before / sell-the-session-after construct.

nodes.label: de Groot, Huij & Zhou (2012) - Weekly Reversal in Large Caps
nodes.rationale: Claims the reversal edge survives costs ONLY in large caps, which made E16 the direct test. The prereg disclosed counter-evidence up front: this project's own fill-timing ablation argues the next-open version underperforms the paper's close-based construct.
nodes.norm_label: de groot, huij & zhou (2012) - weekly reversal in large caps

nodes.label: Cohen, Malloy & Pomorski (2012) - Routine vs Opportunistic Insider Trades
nodes.rationale: Source for E19's routine-vs-opportunistic pattern-break classifier - the CMP classifier whose 95% pass-through falsified the prediction that routine filings would absorb the contamination.
nodes.norm_label: cohen, malloy & pomorski (2012) - routine vs opportunistic insider trades

nodes.label: Blitz, Huij, Lansdorp & Verbeek (2013) - Short-Term Residual Reversal
nodes.rationale: Source for C1: strip each name's trailing-month return of its Fama-French market/size/value loading and rank on the residual, which is what cuts the factor-driven variance behind E16's 65.9% drawdown.
nodes.norm_label: blitz, huij, lansdorp & verbeek (2013) - short-term residual reversal

nodes.label: Moreira & Muir (2017) - Volatility-Managed Portfolios
nodes.rationale: Source for C4's inverse-volatility sizing overlay.

nodes.label: Cederburg, O'Doherty, Wang & Yan (2020) - Vol-Managed Out-of-Sample
nodes.rationale: C4's disclosed counter-evidence: the volatility-managed effect largely fails to survive real-time out-of-sample testing. The prereg was written EXPECTING that, which is why the 0.77-vs-0.80 near-miss was not tuned.
nodes.norm_label: cederburg, o'doherty, wang & yan (2020) - vol-managed out-of-sample

nodes.label: Boehmer, Jones & Zhang (2008) - Short Sellers Are Informed
nodes.rationale: Lineage for C5/X3's short-volume signal. Disclosed contamination up front: market-maker hedging shorts inflate the ratio, and the long-only leg is the weaker side of the documented effect - both borne out by X3's zero spread.
nodes.norm_label: boehmer, jones & zhang (2008) - short sellers are informed

nodes.label: Cieslak, Morse & Vissing-Jorgensen (2019) - FOMC Cycle
nodes.rationale: Source for C6's even-week cycle. C6 replicated it exactly in the gate window and then found it INVERTED post-2014 - the cleanest publication-decay exhibit in the program.

nodes.label: Augustin, Cheng & Van den Bergen (2021) - Volmageddon / XIV Termination
nodes.rationale: Why C7's prereg REQUIRED a hard drawdown kill-switch: Feb 5 2018 cut short-vol ETPs >90% in one session and terminated XIV. That has to be modeled honestly, not backtested past.
nodes.norm_label: augustin, cheng & van den bergen (2021) - volmageddon / xiv termination

nodes.label: Hou, Xue & Zhang - Replication and Microcap Dependence
nodes.rationale: With McLean-Pontiff and Avramov-Cheng-Metzker, supplies the survey's structural argument: documented edges live in illiquid names that the liquidity floor excludes, and K=1-3 concentration destroys diversified-decile edges. It is why the remaining candidates were predicted to fail before they were run.
nodes.norm_label: hou, xue & zhang - replication and microcap dependence

nodes.label: Jiang, Kelly & Xiu (2023) - CNN Chart-Image Classifiers
nodes.rationale: Explicitly declared OUT OF SCOPE for M11 rather than quietly ignored: image predictivity is real but ML-driven and cross-sectional over thousands of names, not rule-based K=1-3. Evan specified rule-based, not LLM/ML.
nodes.norm_label: jiang, kelly & xiu (2023) - cnn chart-image classifiers

nodes.label: Womack - Analyst Recommendation-Change Drift
nodes.rationale: Source for X5. Its buy side is the documented-weak side, which is why X5's prior is FAIL even before the $22 data gate.

nodes.label: E1 short-horizon reversal experiment
nodes.rationale: First pre-registered experiment; VERDICT FAIL with no tuning. More than half the measured edge sat in the close-to-next-open gap, so it died on execution timing rather than on signal absence.

nodes.rationale: FAIL (clean, survivorship-aware design); 6.27% gate CAGR, lost to its own universe's equal-weight buy-and-hold.

nodes.rationale: Composed the surviving PROPERTIES of prior experiments into candidate return engines. Binding disclosure: designs made after seeing 31 results on the same two windows carry a severe data-snooping prior, so any in-window pass is capped IN-SAMPLE-COMPOSED.

nodes.label: M10-1 Nagel Switch
nodes.rationale: VIX-gated regime switch (C1 residual reversal when VIX>20, E6 trend when VIX<=20). The program's FIRST numerical PASS-HR in 32 attempts - and labelled PROMISING / FORWARD PAPER REQUIRED, never a clean pass: gate DD clears the 60% ceiling by 0.05pp, fails at a nearby VIX threshold of 18, and inherits C1's survivor-universe uninterpretability.

nodes.label: M10-2 gap-amortized stress IBS
nodes.rationale: FAIL; closes E2's close-to-close mirage permanently by measuring how much of the gap edge is reachable with a multi-day hold.

nodes.label: M11 chart-pattern detector
nodes.rationale: FAIL, signal-dead. Closed the chart-pattern family and showed survivorship bias destroys the apparent pattern edge. Its causal pivot detector was later reused verbatim as a validation-harness subject.

nodes.label: M12 constraint-relaxation factorial
nodes.rationale: 2x2 over horizon and breadth on a frozen 142-name universe. Diagnostic only, no PASS/FAIL issued. Its published SEC numbers were later found wrong (stale-cache contamination) and corrected.

nodes.label: e6_1x live paper sleeve
nodes.rationale: Simplest sleeve, single instrument - chosen to run first precisely because a plumbing bug there is least likely to corrupt the evidence trail.

nodes.label: e18_vixts live paper sleeve
nodes.rationale: Holds its position and returns None with a stated reason whenever VIX or VIX3M is unavailable - it never guesses a signal.

nodes.label: m10_1_nagel live paper sleeve
nodes.rationale: Weekly decision cadence; the sleeve M3 actually exists to validate, since M10-1's pass is in-sample-composed and only forward evidence can make it real.

nodes.label: swing_bot/prices.py price fetcher
nodes.rationale: Built because Trading's price_cache lacks OHLC. Drops any NaN O/H/L/C row, which is what makes an incomplete same-session Yahoo bar fall back safely to the prior complete session.

nodes.label: swing_bot/paper_sleeves.py
nodes.rationale: Sleeve ledger schema plus decide_e6_1x / decide_e18_vixts / decide_m10_1, each reusing the IDENTICAL signal condition as its backtest runner - load-bearing for M3's implementation-fidelity criterion.

nodes.label: swing_bot/alpaca_client.py
nodes.rationale: Ported, not imported, from the Trading repo. Paper base URL default; per-sleeve client factory so the three accounts stay isolated.

nodes.label: swing_bot/costs.py cost model
nodes.rationale: Friction is MEASURED from real fills or it RAISES - no constant fallback. An explicit override taints every downstream artifact with friction_source=ASSUMED so an assumption can never be read as a measurement.

nodes.label: swing_bot/validation.py
nodes.rationale: Houses purged K-fold, CPCV, DSR and PBO; treats the trial log as a hard input that raises if missing or stale.

nodes.label: scripts/daily_swing_paper.py nightly loop
nodes.rationale: One evening run realizes the prior run's pending fill at today's known open, then stores today's close signal as pending for tomorrow - mirroring every backtest runner's signal-at-close/execute-next-open timing.

nodes.label: scripts/daily_swing_paper.bat
nodes.rationale: Pure ASCII by hard rule. Its trailing echo used to swallow the child exit code so the scheduler could only ever report success; now propagates via exit /b %RC%.

nodes.label: scripts/run_e8_squeeze.py (de-facto shared data layer)
nodes.rationale: An experiment runner that became the repo's shared data layer; 31 files import it. That accidental centrality is why every cache defect in it is a project-wide defect.

nodes.label: cache_fetch() shared cache accessor
nodes.rationale: Top god node of the knowledge graph (36 edges, betweenness 0.193, bridging 19 communities). Refetches only on a cache MISS for the tickers the running script names, which is why a partial refresh cannot be assumed to work.

nodes.label: _note_vintage() cache freshness guard
nodes.rationale: Now measures staleness against the CLOCK, not against sibling series: comparing series to each other needs len(distinct)>1, which is unreachable in a single-ticker script, and comparing to the newest date on disk cannot catch uniform staleness because the max equals the value under test.

nodes.label: StaleCacheError exception class
nodes.rationale: A named RuntimeError subclass, so nothing that already caught RuntimeError changes behaviour but a consumer can re-raise it by name ahead of its broad handler.

nodes.label: scripts/prove_cache_guard.py standing proof
nodes.rationale: Eight cases proving the freshness guard actually fires at every swallow site, including a fresh-vintage silence case (a guard that always fires is as useless as one that never does) and a real-network-error case (proving the moved retry loop still retries four times).

nodes.label: scripts/run_m12_factorial.py
nodes.rationale: Truncates the date axis to the EARLIEST final bar and prints MIXED-VINTAGE CACHE loudly, so the contamination that corrupted its own published numbers is now loud instead of silent.

nodes.label: swing_bot.test_frozen frozen tripwire
nodes.rationale: 12 pinned numeric refs at d=+/-0.0000pp plus 17 invariants; the project's required done-check after any change. One invariant scans every scripts/*.py that mentions cache_fetch for an adjustment-convention header.

nodes.label: scripts/build_trial_log.py
nodes.rationale: Extracts DSR's trial count from first-party artifacts (prereg docs, git, results docs, the record) rather than prose, because the trial count is the easiest input in the method to fudge.

nodes.label: docs/trial_log.json machine-readable trial log
nodes.rationale: Records 37 prereg docs, a highest attempt number of 38 and 50 declared variants as a LOWER BOUND. The 37-vs-38 discrepancy was left unresolved on purpose and a pre-registered rule says DSR uses the LARGER figure, since a too-low trial count flatters the strategy.

nodes.label: .e8e9_cache research data layer
nodes.rationale: 292 files in one filename namespace across three shapes; only the 181 bar lists carry a vintage the guard can see. All five vintages are stale, so 'delete the stale entries' has no non-empty complement, and no enumerator or refresh tool exists anywhere in the repo.

nodes.label: Trading repo price_cache (read-only dependency)
nodes.rationale: Split-adjusted, dividend-UNADJUSTED; read-only from this project. Lacks OHLC, which forced this project to build its own fetcher.

nodes.label: Frozen 142-name M12 universe
nodes.rationale: Frozen by a pre-declared cutoff that excluded GS. All 142 still trade today, so the universe is biased in the strategy's favour and only a FAIL is clean.

nodes.label: alpaca_keys.env credential file
nodes.rationale: Gitignore status was verified BEFORE anything else was written to it; confirmed never tracked on any branch by git log --all.

nodes.label: SwingTradingDailyPaper scheduled task
nodes.rationale: Weekly Mon-Fri 19:00 local, one invocation running all three sleeves together. Converted to S4U so it runs unattended without a stored password.

nodes.label: fill_divergence sim-vs-broker instrument
nodes.rationale: Measures real slippage between the simulated and broker fill. Cannot be calibrated yet: n=4 fills against a required 20, three of them the same ticker/side, and the -85.7 bps outlier is a documented discipline break rather than spread.

nodes.label: paper_nav forward-evidence series
nodes.rationale: 20 sessions 2026-07-15..2026-08-12 with exactly one permanent hole at 2026-07-30.

nodes.label: graphify-out/ knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: Rebuilt from 381 nodes / ZERO edges to 725 nodes / 1094 edges. Now a stale oracle: six tracked files still encode 16 invariants and the old timezone rationale and know nothing of the newest code, while a standing rule says to query it first.

nodes.label: Pre-registration before results
nodes.rationale: Every attempt commits a doc-only prereg with fixed rules and criteria, verified that no runner existed at that commit. Rationale: it makes a FAIL uninterpretable-as-tuning and is the one property that keeps a long string of failures evidentially useful. Risk appetite may change gate NUMBERS, never rigor DISCIPLINE.

nodes.label: D1 dual verdict tiers
nodes.rationale: Two pre-declared bars judged together: PASS-HR (high return) and PASS-RA (risk-adjusted). Added so a strategy that is genuinely risk-improving is not scored as a failure by a return-only bar, and vice versa.

nodes.label: PASS-HR gate (CAGR >= 15% and maxDD <= 60%, both windows)
nodes.rationale: Return-centric with a loosened-but-present drawdown ceiling, matching the stated high-return concentrated goal.
nodes.norm_label: pass-hr gate (cagr >= 15% and maxdd <= 60%, both windows)

nodes.label: PASS-RA gate (Sharpe >= 0.80, > SPY both windows, +CAGR both)
nodes.norm_label: pass-ra gate (sharpe >= 0.80, > spy both windows, +cagr both)

nodes.label: Survivorship bias
nodes.rationale: yfinance holds only currently-listed names, so every backtest is upper-bound biased. The standing consequence: on a survivor universe only a FAIL is clean evidence; a PASS is uninterpretable.

nodes.label: Mixed-vintage cache contamination
nodes.rationale: Cache entries are written on whatever day a ticker is first touched, so a universe can hold several end dates. A union date axis then marks short names at ZERO, and because the evaluation window terminates wherever the data stops each series silently sets its own CAGR denominator. It corrupted a committed, pushed results doc.

nodes.label: The 'guard that cannot fire' defect class
nodes.rationale: The project's one recurring defect, headline of five consecutive audits: a threshold below the mathematical minimum of what it guards, a parameter no caller passes, a check needing two series in a single-series script, a raise caught by the function that raises it, and a namespace split that would break an except clause. Standing rule: when you add a guard, prove it fires by feeding it the trigger.
nodes.norm_label: the 'guard that cannot fire' defect class

nodes.label: Swallowed-raise trap
nodes.rationale: A correct raise caught by a broad except in its own caller. Worse than the printing it replaced at the per-ticker sites, where it converted 'refuse to run' into 'run on a silently emptied universe'. Feeding a guard its trigger proves the guard works; it does not prove anyone lets the failure through.

nodes.label: Clock-based staleness measurement
nodes.rationale: Only the clock sits outside the set being tested, so it is the only reference that closes the uniform-staleness case. The checks RAISE rather than print, because printing WAS the defect: the warning scrolls past and the number is believed.

nodes.label: SWING_ALLOW_STALE_CACHE / SWING_MAX_CACHE_STALE_DAYS
nodes.rationale: Escape hatch and tolerance (default 5 calendar days). Deliberately left un-hardened: the allow flag rejects anything but '1' and so fails CLOSED, and a bad tolerance value raises at import - loud, before any broker call - whereas a try/except default would silently discard the operator's stated tolerance.

nodes.label: Append-only record discipline
nodes.rationale: Prior appendices are never edited; a later entry corrects an earlier one and both stand. The one disclosed exception was an entry corrected before it had ever been committed, where both edits made it less flattering.

nodes.label: /landing-check fresh-agent sweep
nodes.rationale: A fresh agent is given the ARTIFACTS only - diff, commits, docs as specimens - and explicitly denied the session's account of what the work did, because a session's recollection is not a source of truth about the repo.

nodes.label: Cold audit method
nodes.rationale: A fresh auditor with no session history and no 'this part is known-good', run precisely because the session that built the code cannot audit it. Repeatedly found that prior fixes were detective but not corrective.

nodes.label: Refute pass over asserted defects
nodes.rationale: Every claimed defect is handed to an independent agent instructed to REFUTE it, defaulting to REFUTED when uncertain. It overturned 8 of 24 claims - mostly dated historical statements that were exact when written and would have been corrupted by 'fixing' them.

nodes.label: One-window death pattern
nodes.rationale: The program's signature failure: a rule works in the stressed window and gives the Sharpe back in the calm one. Confirmed six times across US equity, non-US equity, crypto, credit and gold - which is why trend gating is classified as drawdown control, not return enhancement.

nodes.label: Cost drag as the binding constraint
nodes.rationale: The mechanistic tell is that an effect GROWS when costs triple; turnover falling 50.5x -> 8.3x/yr is what makes the long horizon win. 'The signal is smaller than the toll' is a different and more useful finding than 'the signal does not exist'.
nodes.norm_label: cost drag as the binding constraint

nodes.label: Decorrelation is not the scarce resource, EDGE is
nodes.rationale: Three consecutive decorrelation attempts each cleared a 0.30 correlation bar comfortably (+0.089 / -0.191 / -0.057) and each failed profitability. Uncorrelated return streams are easy to find; ones with a surviving retail-net edge are not.
nodes.norm_label: decorrelation is not the scarce resource, edge is

nodes.label: IN-SAMPLE-COMPOSED verdict cap
nodes.rationale: Any pass from a design built after seeing prior results on the same windows is labelled forward-paper-required and never a live claim, because an in-window pass composed with hindsight is weaker evidence than the falsifications that preceded it.

nodes.label: Signal at close, execute next open
nodes.rationale: Hard rule: EOD data only, no intraday logic until an intraday source exists. The live loop mirrors this exactly so the forward test measures the same rule the backtest did.
nodes.norm_label: signal at close, execute next open

nodes.label: Mandatory liquidity floor
nodes.rationale: Required in any universe filter because at $100-1,000 spread and slippage dominate. For a long stretch it was UNENFORCEABLE - defined once, read nowhere, then read only behind a branch that had never executed.

nodes.label: Split-adjusted / dividend-UNADJUSTED convention
nodes.rationale: Every price consumer must state it in a header comment. Its cost is visible in X8: coupon-bearing TLT is materially understated, so bonds cannot be read cleanly - logged as a data-layer gap, not an experiment limitation.

nodes.label: Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR)
nodes.rationale: Asks whether a Sharpe survives the trial count. Discriminated perfectly three ways: 0.0001 noise / 0.0168 chart patterns / 1.0000 planted edge. At N=50 trials the expected best per-period Sharpe under the null is +0.0694, which is why the rule's annualised 0.695 does not survive deflation.

nodes.label: Probability of Backtest Overfitting (PBO via CSCV)
nodes.rationale: A SELECTION-level test, not a strategy-level one. It is meaningful only over a configuration set that represents a genuine selection choice - asking it about edge was the mis-specification, and it correctly but uselessly rejected a known planted edge at PBO 0.514.
nodes.norm_label: probability of backtest overfitting (pbo via cscv)

nodes.label: Purged K-fold and CPCV
nodes.rationale: K=6 with a 1% embargo; purge+embargo demonstrably removes 70 observations per split (2971 -> 2901), which is the check that it is actually wired in rather than nominally present. CPCV's 15 paths are reported as a distribution because for concentrated books the median is not the mean.

nodes.label: V1 cost model + validation harness
nodes.rationale: Built against a deliberately worthless signal, with an INVERTED done-check: success is the harness REJECTING both subjects. Reported FAIL under its own pre-registered criteria because criterion 2 was mis-specified as an AND of two unrelated tests - not retuned after seeing results.

nodes.label: V2 acceptance-criterion amendment
nodes.rationale: Split the criterion so DSR governs strategy-level rejection and PBO governs selection-level rejection, with either axis able to fire. Written as a NEW dated prereg; V1's failure stands unedited. Its section 4 predicted the resulting false positive before the re-run, and the prediction held.

nodes.label: V3 (scope PBO to genuine selection sets)
nodes.rationale: Deferred until the live loop accumulates enough measured fills - a gate then measured to be UNREACHABLE on the current trajectory.
nodes.norm_label: v3 (scope pbo to genuine selection sets)

nodes.label: Planted-edge falsifier
nodes.rationale: A reported-not-gated control containing a KNOWN edge. It exists because a harness that rejects everything satisfies its acceptance criteria trivially and carries no information.

nodes.label: Search phase closed at 37 attempts
nodes.rationale: A dated decision, not an abandonment: the space defined by free EOD data, days-to-weeks holds, K=1-3, retail costs and $100-1,000 is exhausted, and what remains in the project's own method survey is either 1-12 month horizon or data-gated. Hunting a 38th rule in the same box has low expected value.

nodes.label: HORIZON binds, breadth does not
nodes.rationale: M12's attribution result, and a self-correction: the project had ASSERTED that retail concentration forbade the breadth the premium requires. Tested, breadth lost - K=20 of 142 is a 14% sort that converges toward the equal-weight benchmark, and it actively destroys the horizon gain.

nodes.label: Forward-evidence phase
nodes.rationale: The one open lever after the search closed. It needs elapsed time, not another attempt, and its product is EVIDENCE rather than returns - which is why sleeve correlation matters more here than it would for a return program.

nodes.label: BLOCKED-ON-EVAN discipline
nodes.rationale: Keys, accounts, purchases, credentials and live-ledger writes are reported and never worked around, and a stub is never passed off as live. Applied to Alpaca account creation, the scheduled-task credential, a one-row ledger UPDATE and a paid-data spend ceiling.

nodes.label: S4U logon type for the nightly task
nodes.rationale: Runs unattended without a stored password, replacing an Interactive task that silently lost sessions whenever Evan was logged off while Windows reported zero missed runs.
nodes.norm_label: s4u logon type for the nightly task

nodes.label: Missed-session detector
nodes.rationale: Rewritten as a set difference over the whole series rather than a max(date) comparison, so it can see an INTERIOR hole - which is what 2026-07-30 was.

nodes.label: Batch exit-code swallowing defect
nodes.rationale: In cmd a batch's exit code is its last command's, so a trailing echo made every run report success. Until fixed, every silent failure downstream was structurally invisible to the scheduler.

nodes.label: Implicit namespace-package import hazard
nodes.rationale: scripts/ has no __init__.py and the repo root is on sys.path, so import X and import scripts.X yield two different exception classes and an except clause silently stops matching. Proven safe today by class identity rather than assumption, and binned as a rule for every cross-script except.

nodes.label: Static-blend impossibility proof
nodes.rationale: A red-team result: PASS-HR from any FIXED-weight combination is arithmetically empty because the two windows demand disjoint weights. The only escape is state-conditioning on a causal variable - which is what selected the Nagel Switch.

nodes.label: The overnight-gap assassin
nodes.rationale: The recurring killer identified by the failure decomposition: more than half of a short-horizon edge lives in the close-to-next-open gap that an EOD executor cannot capture.

nodes.label: Pattern Day Trader rule eliminated
nodes.rationale: The $25,000 minimum-equity PDT designation was eliminated effective 2026-06-04 with an 18-month phase-in. Flagged VERIFY-WITH-BROKER rather than fact-on-the-ground, and read as removing an excuse rather than a constraint - the strategies it unlocks are the high-turnover ones the cost arithmetic punishes hardest.

nodes.label: The three live sleeves are ~one strategy
nodes.rationale: m10_1_nagel runs the identical e6 rule on 69.7% of 4,226 sessions; all three are effectively long simultaneously 65.3% of days. Disclosed as an honest CONSEQUENCE of the evidence - nothing uncorrelated and profitable was ever found to deploy - and NOT fixed by editing a running sleeve, which would break its pre-registration and destroy the accumulated forward evidence.
nodes.norm_label: the three live sleeves are ~one strategy

nodes.label: VIX3M source lag inverted the live signal
nodes.rationale: A Yahoo source lag made a stale VIX3M invert e18's live decision; fixed by moving to a CBOE source and clearing stale pending orders.
nodes.norm_label: vix3m source lag inverted the live signal

nodes.label: Intraday-execution guard
nodes.rationale: Added after a re-fire filled a stale SELL inside the session, which would have broken the signal-at-close/execute-next-open contract the whole forward test rests on.

nodes.label: Quantity-aware broker reconcile
nodes.rationale: Closes share drift between the DB ledger and the broker; verified in production when it closed the e18 share fork at a real open.

nodes.label: A session's recollection is not a source of truth
nodes.rationale: Discovered when HEAD was four commits past where the session believed it was; a handoff written from memory would have pointed a fresh session at work already done. The rule: build handoffs from git log, not from what you remember doing.
nodes.norm_label: a session's recollection is not a source of truth

nodes.label: Verify a change against the state it creates
nodes.rationale: The generalized lesson: a fix that corrects a count can invalidate that count by existing. Proving a guard fires in isolation does not prove a caller lets it through, and checking a claim against the state you found does not check it against the state you made.
nodes.norm_label: verify a change against the state it creates

nodes.label: .claude/codebase-memory bins
nodes.rationale: Eleven bins plus an index, required to be updated in the same session as any fact-changing change. The entire research cache data layer had never appeared in any bin - every 'cache' hit referred to the Trading repo's price_cache.

nodes.label: Nagel (RFS 2012) - reversal alpha as liquidity provision
nodes.rationale: Supplied the causal MECHANISM (not a date) that lets a regime switch escape the static-blend impossibility: reversal compensation scales with VIX. Caveat recorded - its 1998-2010 sample overlaps the gate window, so the mechanism is partly in-sample.
nodes.norm_label: nagel (rfs 2012) - reversal alpha as liquidity provision

nodes.label: Gatev, Goetzmann & Rouwenhorst (2006) - pairs distance method
nodes.rationale: Adopted wholesale at its published defaults so the test could not be accused of parameter mining.
nodes.norm_label: gatev, goetzmann & rouwenhorst (2006) - pairs distance method

nodes.label: Do & Faff (2010) - pairs-trading decay
nodes.rationale: Pre-declared as the FAVORED prior so a FAIL could not later be dressed up as a surprise. H0 won, and the decay reproduced independently on this project's own data.

nodes.label: Sullivan, Timmermann & White (1999) - Reality Check on TA rules
nodes.norm_label: sullivan, timmermann & white (1999) - reality check on ta rules

nodes.label: Bajgrowicz & Scaillet (2012) - FDR on DJIA trading rules
nodes.rationale: An investor could never have selected the future best rules ex ante, and in-sample performance is completely offset by low transaction costs.
nodes.norm_label: bajgrowicz & scaillet (2012) - fdr on djia trading rules

nodes.label: Osler (2003) - FX order-book clustering at round numbers
nodes.rationale: The one classical TA concept with a directly observed order-flow mechanism - but wrong asset class and needs intraday data the EOD-only rule forbids.
nodes.norm_label: osler (2003) - fx order-book clustering at round numbers

nodes.label: Barber, Lee, Liu & Odean - Taiwan day-trader tape
nodes.rationale: More than 8 in 10 day traders lose in a typical semiannual period; -23.9 bps/day net.
nodes.norm_label: barber, lee, liu & odean - taiwan day-trader tape

nodes.label: Bessembinder (2018) - skewness of lifetime stock returns
nodes.rationale: 4.3% of stocks account for all net wealth creation, so K=1-3 is a skewness bet whose median draw loses to cash - which is why evaluation must report the DISTRIBUTION, not the mean of a few runs.
nodes.norm_label: bessembinder (2018) - skewness of lifetime stock returns

nodes.label: George & Hwang (2004) - 52-week high
nodes.rationale: The surviving trend evidence is cross-sectional, diversified and 6-12 months; compressing it to K=1-3 over 5-20 days is an extrapolation outside the evidence and must be tested as one.

nodes.label: Hou, Xue & Zhang - concentration and factor premia
nodes.rationale: Supplied the breadth explanation the project asserted for months; M12 tested it and it lost.
nodes.norm_label: hou, xue & zhang - concentration and factor premia

nodes.label: Xia et al. 2026 (arXiv 2605.19337) - audit of 77 LLM-trading studies
nodes.rationale: 2/19 disclose a time-consistent split, 1/19 a transaction-cost model, 0/19 reach full reproducibility.
nodes.norm_label: xia et al. 2026 (arxiv 2605.19337) - audit of 77 llm-trading studies

nodes.label: Zhu et al. 2026 (KTD-Fin) - masked-ticker LLM evaluation
nodes.rationale: With tickers and calendar masked, frontier LLM agents' returns are explained by passive market and style exposure: the alpha is beta.
nodes.norm_label: zhu et al. 2026 (ktd-fin) - masked-ticker llm evaluation

nodes.label: Lo, Mamaysky & Wang (2000) - chart patterns
nodes.rationale: Chart patterns carry incremental distributional information - not a net-of-cost strategy.

nodes.label: Trading repo momentum_v2 (sister project)
nodes.rationale: Top-50 of ~5,200 monthly, validated IS +21.0% / OOS +26.5% / Sharpe 0.87. It is a 1% sort, which is why M12's 14% sort measures sort strength rather than diversification - and why relaxing concentration here would duplicate the sister project rather than inform this one.

nodes.label: Prereg V3 — scope PBO to selection sets
nodes.rationale: DOC-ONLY pre-registration written 2026-08-13 BEFORE any change to swing_bot/validation.py or scripts/run_v1_harness_check.py and before any re-run. NOT YET EXECUTED — it repairs a falsifier and produces no evidence about any strategy; no sleeve, no attempt, no trial_log entry follows from it and the attempt tally does not move.
nodes.norm_label: prereg v3 — scope pbo to selection sets

nodes.label: SELECTION vs EXCHANGEABLE config-set declaration rule
nodes.rationale: Every configuration set must be declared a priori at the call site as SELECTION (members differ by a parameter/design choice on the same data; PBO computed AND gated) or EXCHANGEABLE (independent realisations of one process differing only by seed; PBO computed and REPORTED, never gated — rejection on the DSR axis alone). Declared: 6.1 chart-pattern = SELECTION, 6.2 pure noise = EXCHANGEABLE, §5 planted edge = EXCHANGEABLE. Placed at the call site in the open rather than inferred, because an inferred version would be a guard nobody can audit.
nodes.norm_label: selection vs exchangeable config-set declaration rule

nodes.label: PBO on an exchangeable set is a category error
nodes.rationale: CSCV asks whether the in-sample-best configuration holds up out-of-sample, which presupposes that choosing between configs is a decision with content.
